items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: So, between Joe Rainey, Clarence and myself, you didn't have to worry much what the piano was doing outside of solos.

ctx.x: So, between Joe Rainey, Clarence and myself, you didn't have to worry much what the piano was doing outside of solos.
